Iran must address its declining population by encouraging young people to marry and have children, according to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.
The country of 93 million faces a demographic crisis, with an aging population and falling birthrate as young couples struggle to afford homes and start families amid a deepening economic slump.
In a statement attributed to him on Tuesday, Khamenei said Iran must address shortcomings in past population policies, describing population growth as a “strategic priority.”
His message was read at a ceremony for the National Population Rejuvenation Award, which honors efforts to help families and increase Iran’s birth rate.

Jerusalem —
Israel’s military assault on Gaza has caused severe environmental contamination, with signs of toxic pollution found across the entire territory, according to a report published by Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory (CEOBS).
The report, published Monday, said the extensive use of explosive and incendiary weapons, airstrikes and fires has made the air, soil and water too dangerous for inhabitants now and for decades to come.
The scale and intensity of Israel’s bombardment have affected around 78% of Gaza’s landmass, with more than 99% of the territory experiencing potential contamination, the groups’ study found.

Ukraine sank a Russian warship docked in Libya and disabled a cargo vessel off the North African country’s coast, President Volodymyr Zelensky said Monday, in Kyiv’s latest attack on Russian assets far from the front lines.
The warship — identified as the 344-foot navy corvette Merkury — was attacked with seven maritime drones, sinking the ship and destroying a combat helicopter on board, Zelensky said in a post to Telegram.
Dramatic footage Zelensky released showed Ukrainian sea drones speeding toward the ship –– one of the newest ships in Russia’s fleet — which erupted into a giant ball of flames in the dock in Benghazi in eastern Libya. Photos taken by satellite imagery company Vantor showed the vessel submerged following the attack.
